# `storage` operations

1 operation. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all references](index.md).

### storage.prune

Clean up old jobs and reports. **destructive, ask first**, idempotent.

List, and with apply remove, what Tomacco keeps of finished work under its data directory: records and logs of jobs that ended before older_than_days, log files without a job, and report directories under reports/. A dry run by default; also reports the size of each top-level entry of the data directory. Never touches queued or running jobs, emulators, SDKs, the virtual iOS device, settings, or artifacts in projects.

- `older_than_days` number (0 to 3650; default 30)
- `max_job_log_mb` integer (0 to 1000000): Also remove the oldest finished jobs until their logs take at most this much
- `include` array of string (items one of jobs, reports; at least 1 item; default ["jobs","reports"])
- `apply` boolean (default false): Remove the candidates; without it nothing is changed

```sh
tomaccoctl call storage.prune
```
